steps.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: 16:9 game backdrop. Primary request: a sunlit botanical observation nook for a little bean plant, warm cream journal paper world with a low wooden potting bench along the lower edge, terracotta pots and small garden tools tucked around the far sides, delicate bean vines and loose watercolor leaves framing the outer edges, a broad quiet uncluttered center for the interactive smiling pot. Style/medium: soft gouache and watercolour nature illustration on warm cream paper #f7f1e3, the look of a naturalist's notebook; leaf greens, sky blues and earth browns; visible paper grain, light pencil under-drawing showing through, quieter and more textured than the other worlds. No text, no letters, no words. Composition/framing: wide 16:9 view with a broad uncluttered center and lower-centre observation space, richly painted botanical detail only around crop-safe outer edges. Lighting/mood: soft honey-gold morning light, peaceful, curious, welcoming for ages 3 to 6. Constraints: environment only; preserve a clear open floor for separately composited sprites. Avoid: characters, creatures, people, food or loose hero objects in the performance area, text, letters, logo, watermark, UI, border, collage, photorealism, 3D.
